name: Still Waters
description: A quiet backwater where the reeds part over deep, dark water. Fish rise to snap at the surface, and at night something down there glows.

discovery.message: The water here is deep and still, dimpled with rising fish.

bank.text: The water is deep and slow under the reeds. Carp and mudcat lurk down there, and Shadowmere folk swear the glowfin come up after dark.

leave.text: You reel in, break down the rod, and move on.
